title: Disc profile
description: What a restoration expects of its original disc, and the image formats its importer reads. Read by dinorefurb-disc-archiver.

title.description: The edition, as a person would recognise it.

restoration.description: The restoration that reads this disc.

layout.description: data-only: one ISO 9660 data track. mixed-mode: a data track followed by CD audio tracks.

volumeIdentifier.description: The primary volume descriptor's volume identifier; compared ignoring case.

expectedPaths.description: Files or directories on the data track, relative to its root; compared ignoring case.

recommendedFormats.description: The formats ticked by default: the ones the restoration's importer reads.

notes.description: Shown to the person choosing the profile.
